product.description: Monoprice Origin Direct Burial Series Speaker wire feature a robust moisture resistant polyethylene jacket paired with a water blocking tape, providing many years of reliable conductivity.Available in a variety of lengths and gauges, you can choose two-conductor versions, for connecting a single speaker, or four-conductor versions for connecting speaker pairs. The pure bare copper conductors are sheathed in color-coded jackets contained within the main moisture resistant jacket.
